Photoshoot 1.5.1 brings 27 new effects, masks that react to your face, prints you can design, and automatic updates.

- **27 new effects.** Film, Disposable, Soft Glam, Dreamy, Golden Hour, Noir, VHS, Duotone, Lomo, Sparkles, Hearts, Rainbow, Glitch, Neon, Halftone and Pixel, plus Kaleidoscope and Edge Work from earlier Photo Booth releases.
- **Masks that react.** Puppy, Kitty, Rainbow Mouth, Heart Eyes, Flower Crown, Seeing Stars, Blush, Glam and Doe Eyes. Open your mouth, raise your eyebrows or smile and they respond. A short hint tells you what to try.
- **Everyone in the picture.** Face effects follow up to four people at once.
- **Face effects fixed.** Bug Out, Chipmunk, Frog and the other face effects now land on your face. They used to warp the area below it, or the wrong side of the picture when the preview was mirrored.
- **Design your print.** After four photos, add a caption and the date in one of five fonts, three sizes, any alignment and six colours, on five paper colours with optional rounded corners. The Photoshoot name is now a small mark in the corner, and you can turn it off.
- **Tall strips fit** when you view them, and a short tutorial explains four-photo mode the first time you use it.
- **New sounds:** a mechanical shutter, a clean countdown beep and a printer whir when your four photos are done.
- **Automatic updates.** From this version on, the installed Windows app downloads new versions in the background and installs them when you restart. What's New shows the changes after each update. Turn it off in Settings → Advanced.

Download `Photoshoot-1.5.1-x64.exe` for the Windows 10/11 installer or `Photoshoot-1.5.1-portable.exe` for the portable app (the portable app tells you about updates but can't install them itself). SHA-256 hashes are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

These executables are unsigned, so Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning (choose More info, then Run anyway). No signed or notarised macOS release is included.

[Open the browser app](https://photoshoot-yeegz.web.app/app/).
